A '''statue''' of [[IG-11]] was erected on the [[planet]] [[Nevarro]]<ref name="Siege" /> after the reprogrammed [[assassin droid]] had sacrificed [[Gender|himself]] to save [[Din Grogu|Grogu]], [[Din Djarin]], [[Carasynthia Dune]], and [[Greef Karga]] during the [[clash on Nevarro]]. The [[droid]]'s sacrifice had been a vital part in securing the liberation of the planet from [[Gideon's Imperial remnant]].<ref name="Chapter 8">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 8: Redemption}}</ref>

It was located in the marketplace of [[Nevarro City]], near the entrance to the [[Nevarro school|school]].<ref name="Siege" /> Part of the statue has been composed from the actual scorched remains of the droid.<ref name="Chapter 17" />

In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> the head and torso of the statue being the original surviving parts form the explosion was taken down by Din Djarin, in an effort to repair IG-11.<ref name="Chapter 17" /> Despite their failed attempt at repairing the assassin droid, Karga never put the components back on the statue; he instead ordered the Anzellans to repurpose IG-11 into a [[mech]] for Grogu to ride on and renaming it as [[IG-12]].<ref name="Chapter 23">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 23: The Spies}}</ref>
